description: Main class for handling data files in the Apache OFBiz framework, including reading, writing, and managing records and definitions.

classes.name: DataFile
classes.description: Handles parsing, storing, and writing data file records, along with managing data file definitions.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Static method to load a data file from a URL using a definition URL and data file name.

methods.name: makeDataFile
methods.description: Creates a DataFile instance based on a definition URL and data file name.

methods.name: DataFile
methods.description: Constructor that initializes DataFile with a model data file.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description: Returns the list of records in the data file.

methods.name: addRecord
methods.description: Adds a record to the data file.

methods.name: makeRecord
methods.description: Creates a new record based on a record name.

methods.name: writeDataFile
methods.description: Writes the data file records to a specified filename or output stream.
